provenance.note: R7: bench/native_flash.py (pinned in the input package; created in DEVELOPMENT) empties run/FprimeRustReference/, copies the delivered executable (no suffix) to {install}, chmod +x, and prints 'Serial# = native-<hostname>'; bench/native_dump.py (same) copies {install} back to {readback} so fth's flash read-back hashes equal to the image. The GDS launches the app from run/FprimeRustReference/ (fresh PrmDb.dat per run).

notes: Native Linux x86_64 host, no hardware. Relative paths only, from the campaign root; the dictionary path is the uut build-artifacts tree and relies on the package's dictionary rewrite (fth run.effective_bench → sealed dict). fprime-gds launches the executable itself (--app; no -n) and the deployment's Drv.TcpClient connects to the GDS server on 127.0.0.1:50000; framing is the fprime-gds default (space packets), matching ComCcsds.Subtopology — DEVELOPMENT confirms on the dry run. The GDS owns the process: a non-zero exit of the app is a bench fault, not a UUT fact. No reset row: the plan acknowledges L3 as not covered.
